name: sysmocap

scripts.dmg: node builddmgjsonx86.js && cat dmgcfg.json && node `npm root -g`/appdmg/bin/appdmg.js ./dmgcfg.json ./OutApp/packages/SysMocap-macOS-x64.dmg && rm ./dmgcfg.json
scripts.dmgarm: node builddmgjsonarm.js && cat dmgcfg.json && node `npm root -g`/appdmg/bin/appdmg.js ./dmgcfg.json ./OutApp/packages/SysMocap-macOS-arm64.dmg && rm ./dmgcfg.json

author: xianfei
comment:deps: Build-only packages (bundled into dist/assets, or copied to dist/node_modules via vite-plugin-static-copy) live in devDependencies so @electron/packager prunes them from the shipped node_modules. Runtime deps stay here: required by the (un-bundled) main.js / webserv, OR served from /node_modules to the web client (three, @pixiv/three-vrm, kalidokit, socket.io).
